_doc: Layer registry: the top level of the data taxonomy. Layer -> Group -> Metric. Adding a data domain means adding a layer here; the app builds its navigation from the manifest and needs no code change.

_kinds.metric: Choropleth data. MUTUALLY EXCLUSIVE -- exactly one metric colors the map at a time, because a polygon has one fill. Selecting a new metric replaces the current one.
_kinds.overlay: Drawn on top of the choropleth. ADDITIVE -- any number can be visible at once (neighborhood outlines + transit lines + parks). Overlays carry no index/baseline; they are geometry plus labels, not measurements.

layers.label: Census & Demographics
layers.description: American Community Survey 5-year estimates. Annual, small-area, survey-based -- every value carries a margin of error.

provider.name: US Census Bureau
provider.attribution: US Census Bureau, American Community Survey 5-Year Estimates

layers.label: Politics & Elections
layers.description: Precinct and county election returns. NOTE: election geography is precincts, which do not nest inside census tracts and are redrawn frequently. Expect this layer to declare its own geoLevels rather than reusing the census ones -- which is exactly why geoLevels is a per-layer field.

provider.name: Ohio Secretary of State / MIT Election Lab
provider.attribution: MIT Election Data and Science Lab

layers.label: Climate & Weather
layers.description: NOAA historical summaries. Station POINTS, not polygons -- values must be interpolated onto areas before they can be a choropleth, and that interpolation is an estimate that has to be disclosed.

provider.name: NOAA NCEI
provider.attribution: NOAA National Centers for Environmental Information

layers.label: Neighborhoods
layers.description: Civic-association and named-place boundaries from Columbus open data. Display only: these do not nest inside census geography, so statistics are NOT recomputed onto them. Drawn as labeled outlines over whatever metric is active.

layers.label: Places & Infrastructure
layers.description: Parks, transit, schools from OpenStreetMap via Overpass. Extracted at build time only -- Overpass is heavily rate-limited and must never be called from the browser.
